findings.title: plannedTasks' materialised-tasks branch is never verified
findings.detail: plannedTasks(bdir, st) short-circuits to 0 when len(st.Tasks) > 0 (cmd_status.go:178-180), which is exactly the state a normal run is in once it leaves the plan phase (plan.index.json is never deleted after materialiseTasks, so it still sits on disk in execute/finish phase). No test in this diff or pre-existing exercises this branch with an assertion on the tasks/planned output: the new TestStatusPlanPhaseSaysPlannedAndConfirmedClauses only covers the plan-phase case (st.Tasks empty, index present, planned=4); the pre-existing reviewerRun fixture (record_reviewer_test.go:23-49) does set st.Tasks non-empty alongside a real plan.index.json and is used by status tests such as TestStatusInternalReviewSkipped/TestStatusInternalReviewZeroCandidatesNotVerifyPending, but those tests never assert on the 'tasks' or 'planned' fields — so they exercise the line without verifying it. If the early return were dropped (e.g. plannedTasks always parsed the index and returned len(idx.Tasks) whenever it succeeded), every execute/finish-phase status call for a run whose plan.index.json is still on disk would wrongly report 'N planned (not yet materialised)' instead of real task counts, and no test would fail.
